name: The St. Regis Doha
positioning: St. Regis hotel in Doha's West Bay on the Arabian Gulf, with a private beach, butler service included with every booking and sixteen restaurants and cocktail bars
best_for: Families wanting a private beach, a pool and a kids learning center in the city
Food-focused travelers who want many restaurants and bars in one hotel

facts.text: The hotel is in Doha's West Bay area, with views of the Arabian Gulf, West Bay and the adjacent Pearl Island.
The hotel is near Katara Cultural Village.
The hotel has a collection of sixteen restaurants and cocktail bars.
Astor Grill offers the St. Regis sabrage ritual with its classic cocktails.
Vine's Friday brunches pair global dishes with live music.
The afternoon tea is inspired by Caroline Astor.
The Engine Room combines a love of classic cars with cigars.
All guest room and suite bookings include St. Regis Butler Service.
Bathrooms are marble, with a deep soaking tub and a separate rain shower.
Rooms have neo-classical decor with a blue carpet and silk drapery.
Guests have access to both a private beach and a pool, and the outdoor pool overlooks the Arabian Gulf.
The Kids Learning Center offers drawing and coloring, tailored educational lessons, music and outdoor adventures.

highlights.text: Guerlain designed spa rituals exclusive to The St. Regis Doha, including 'Waves of sand' and 'Pearl of Doha'.
Vilebrequin La Plage is a beachfront restaurant celebrating the flavors of Provence.
Hakkasan at the hotel is a modern Cantonese fine dining concept founded in London.
Families can book a desert safari to the south of Qatar with professional drivers.
Guests can ride jet skis along the hotel's private beach.

considerations.text: During Ramadan, select dining venues are closed during daylight hours; guests can gather at the Asateer Ramadan Tent instead.
The hotel does not provide a shuttle service; Hamad International Airport is approximately 23 kilometers away.
Children must always be accompanied by a parent, guardian or nanny in the Kids Club facilities.
